{{Quote|The Qrephs grew up poor&mdash;so poor they had to share a powerbody.| [[Luewet Wuul]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
A '''powerbody''' was an artificial body used to bear the weight of the atrophied bodies of members of the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Columi brothers [[Craitheus Qreph|Qreph]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] spent their early life in poverty following the untimely [[Death/Legends|death]] of their [[Mama (information broker)|mother]] and had to share a single powerbody.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
Later in life, the Qreph brothers became wealthy businessmen and each possessed their own [[vanalloy]] powerbody, capable of hovering and containing in-built [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] for communication. Marvid's power body was ornate and was fitted with a weapon system and also a [[vidcam]] concealed in the chest.<ref name="Crucible" />
{{Tech-stub}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
Powerbodies appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
